instructions: Use one copy per candidate question only after the current coverage audit identifies a prospective construct gap.
Do not select an item because a participant answer, chart, score, hit, or miss suggests it would help.
Treat repeated probes as multiple indicators of one construct, not independent confirmations.
Freeze accepted wording, mappings, scoring rules, and analysis lane before participant answers are inspected.
Item count is an output of the adequacy review, never an input or quota.
acceptance_condition: smallest questionnaire that adequately represents the prospectively defined construct space with sufficient independent evidence and acceptable response quality
